title: Schooling at St. Catherine
summary: He went to Catholic school and St. Catherine School on Tulane Avenue.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: There's one thing we always forget to ask people about their school, where they went to school when they were a kid. I don't remember if you told.
Yeah, well, I come up through Catholic school. I used to go to Miss Jeanette until I made my first communion. And after I made first communion, my mother continued with the St. Catherine School.
